description: FwDET is the Floodwater Depth Estimation Tool developed by Sagy Cohen and collaborators. It estimates water depths from a mapped flood extent and a digital elevation model, with versions for ArcGIS, QGIS and Google Earth Engine. Inputs are inundation polygons or masks and elevation; outputs are spatial flood-depth estimates. Geographic coverage and resolution follow the supplied extent and terrain data. Public source is free under GPL-2.0, while ArcGIS and cloud-service requirements apply separately. A limitation is that extent and terrain errors affect inferred depths, and this reconstruction does not simulate the hydraulic evolution of a flood. Later versions improve coastal treatment and boundary filtering, so users must match the implementation to the documented method. FwDET can prepare observed-depth estimates for infrastructure exposure analysis and comparison with Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The README links installation guidance and the 2018, 2019 and 2022 method papers. No terrain or flood polygon files were downloaded.
